verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents passing dynamic variables or per-caller context into a call when it is placed. Memory (bland-docs-9) is a related but different feature: the agent recalls people across conversations on its own, rather than a developer injecting context at call time. Batch CSV upload and mid-call custom API tools likewise never mention per-call variable injection, so they are adjacent or building-block evidence and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized
